# msgraph-entra_directory_role (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an Entra ID directory role. Use this to get the template ID needed for role assignments.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the directory role (e.g., 'Global Administrator', 'Security Administrator').

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the directory role.
- `id` (String) The object ID of the directory role instance.
- `template_id` (String) The template ID of the directory role. This is the ID used for role assignments.
